tr.title: in, on, at farkı (yer ve zaman)
tr.metaDesc: in on at farkı: yer ve zaman edatları ne zaman kullanılır? Kurallar ve örneklerle — LinguaBattle.
tr.lede: in, on, at hem yer hem zaman için kullanılan, en çok karıştırılan edatlardır. Kural: genelden özele → in (büyük/içinde), on (yüzey/gün), at (nokta/saat).

means.en: in the room, on the table, at the door

en.title: In, on, at (place & time)
en.metaDesc: In on at difference: when to use these place and time prepositions? Rules and examples — LinguaBattle.
en.lede: in, on, at are the most confused prepositions, used for both place and time. Rule: general to specific → in (big/inside), on (surface/day), at (point/time).

means.en: in the room, on the table, at the door
